title: AI Architect
description:
Shape the Future of Financial Services with Capco

At Capco, we specialize in management consulting and software development, partnering with leading international banks and insurance companies across Western Europe. Our innovative approach and collaborative culture make us the ideal place for professionals looking to make an impact in financial services technology.

Want to learn more about our culture and people? Visit us: Capco Careers Slovakia

Why Join Us?

• Prestigious Clients & Exciting Projects - Work with top-tier banks on transformation projects that redefine financial services.

• Continuous Learning & Development - Access to technical and soft skills training, professional certifications, and full access to the Udemy online learning platform.

• Flexible Work Environment -  we provide flexibility to work remotely from the home office within Czech Republic

• Attractive Benefits Package:
✅ Paid sick days
✅ 25 vacation days (regardless of age)
✅ Monthly cafeteria allowance (1.285 CZK/month) or contribution to the 3rd pillar
✅ Fully paid meal vouchers
✅ Multisport card with employer contribution
✅ Smartphone with 1TB data + Laptop

• Well-being & Community Engagement - Join yoga lessons, mental health webinars, running challenges, sports activities, or participate in our volunteering days.

• Competitive Compensation (adjusted based on experience) + annual bonus & benefits package.

• Long-term career - Indefinite period contract with opportunities for career growth.

 

Role Description

As an AI Architect you will help the world’s most impactful Financial Institutes design agentic platforms. You will take ambiguous client problems and turn them into target architectures, roadmaps and implementation requirements and then create reusable patterns, reference architectures, accelerators and methodologies that other consultants can use.

• Act as the bridge between business functions, IT, and Management to translate functional and non-functional requirements into scalable and efficient agentic architectures.

• Be the high-level advisor for C-suite stakeholders translating their challenges into technical AI roadmaps.

• Design safe and precise memory architectures, compliant multi-agent systems, and tool/skill workbenches.

• Design and oversee implementation of tracing-, monitoring-, and evaluation systems for Agentic AI.

• Jointly with Risk Management/Compliance define and guide the implementation of guardrails and security measures to ensure safe and compliant AI usage.

• Lead the documentation and communication of technical concepts effectively.

 

Skills and Expertise

• Several years of experience in the architecture and delivery of AI solutions in Finance. Experience with Asset Management / Investment Banking preferred.

• Experience with Agent Builder, M365 and PowerBI Copilot, Cowork,

• A deep understanding of modern data platforms like Azure AI Foundry, Databricks, Copilot Studio and Cowork, and their practical applications in technology and finance.

• Proficiency in AgentOps in common cloud environments. Knowledge of Azure preferred.

• Knowledge of both MCP/API-first development practices and traditional service-based architecture.

• Experience with tracing, monitoring, and evaluation systems like Langfuse or Weights & Biases.

• Knowledge of cloud platforms and experience designing cloud-based AI solutions.

• Understanding of AI governance principles and practices.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills for collaboration across technical and non-technical teams.

• Fluency English (German is a big advantage)

✅ Technical Interviews (1-2 rounds, depending on the project ) - Discuss your skills with our experienced Capco colleagues
✅ Feedback & Offer - Receive an offer to join our team!

title: Product Marketing - Senior Manager
locationText: Spain, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom
description:
About Airalo

Alo! Airalo is the world’s first eSIM store that helps people connect in over 200+ countries and regions across the globe. We are building the next digital service that revolutionizes the telecom industry. We are a travel-tech company and an equal-opportunity environment that values and executes diversity, inclusion, and equity. Our team is spread across 50+ countries and six continents. What glues us together is our commitment to changing the way you connect.
Check out more information about Airalo in our Public Handbook:
About you
We hope that you care deeply about the quality of your work, the intrinsic worth of tasks, and the success of your team. You are self-disciplined and do not require micromanagement in terms of your skillset and work ethic. You do your best to flourish as an individual every day while working hard to foster a collaborative team environment. You believe in the importance of being - and staying - authentic, honest, positive, and kind. You are a good interlocutor with clear and concise communication. You are able to manage multiple projects, have an analytical mind, pay keen attention to detail, and love to get your hands dirty. You are cognizant, tolerant, and welcoming of vulnerabilities and cultural differences.
About the Role

Position : Full-time / Employee

Location: Remote-first within the UK or Spain. To be considered for this role, candidates must live in and possess valid work authorization for one of these two countries.

Benefits: Health Insurance, work-from-anywhere stipend, annual wellness & learning credits, annual all-expenses-paid company retreat in a gorgeous destination & other benefits

As the Senior Manager of Product Marketing, you will own how Airalo positions, launches, and grows its product portfolio globally. You'll be the connective tissue between Product, Growth, CRM, Partnerships, and Customer Support - ensuring every team has the messaging, information, and enablement they need to sell and support our products effectively.

This is position reports into the Chief Growth Officer. You will shape the PMM function, set the strategic direction for how we bring our connectivity to market, and directly drive adoption, engagement, and monetization across the Airalo lifecycle.

What you'll do:

Product Positioning & Messaging

• Own Airalo 's product narrative: define clear, differentiated positioning for each product and customer segment (B2C travelers, B2B partners, enterprise).

• Develop and maintain a messaging framework that scales across channels, markets, and languages.

• Ensure consistency between product value and how it's communicated externally.

Go-To-Market Strategy & Customer Insights

• Lead GTM planning for new products, features, and market expansions - from strategy through execution.

• Partner with Growth, CRM, and Partnerships to design integrated launch plans with clear goals, channels, and success metrics.

• Where relevant, develop partner-specific GTM motions in coordination with the Partnerships team.

• Build and maintain a deep understanding of Airalo 's customers, segments, and buying behaviors.

• Commission and synthesize market research, competitive analysis, and customer feedback to inform product and marketing strategy.

• Serve as the internal voice of the customer across Product, Marketing, and Leadership.

Product Adoption & Lifecycle Marketing

• Drive strategies to increase activation, engagement, upsell, and retention across the customer lifecycle.

• Work with CRM, Growth and Product to design lifecycle campaigns grounded in product value and behavioral data.

• Identify and close gaps between product capability and customer awareness/usage.

Product Launch, Planning Support & Enablement

• Partner with Product Management on roadmap planning to ensure marketing is integrated early.

• Define launch tiers and coordinate cross-functional readiness across Marketing, Support, Sales, and Partnerships.

• Own launch retrospectives

title: Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Als Key Account Manager*in verantwortest die Bestandskunden von CARvinci® in Autohäusern und Autohausgruppen - von der Vertragsverlängerung bis zum Ausbau des Accounts. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden - von der Einführung über die laufende Betreuung bis zur strategischen Weiterentwicklung. Du verstehst die Prozesse unserer Kunden im Detail, übersetzt sie in konkrete Lösungen und sorgst dafür, dass unser Produkt echten Mehrwert stiftet. Gleichzeitig bringst du die Erkenntnisse aus dem Kundenkontakt zurück ins Unternehmen und gestaltest unsere internen Abläufe aktiv mit.
Aufgaben

Du führst feste Jour Fixes und Review-Termine mit deinen Key Accounts und identifizierst dabei neue Umsatzpotenziale.
Du baust belastbare Beziehungen auf allen Ebenen auf - vom Fachanwender bis zur Geschäftsführung des Autohauses.
Du verhandelst Vertragsverlängerungen und Erweiterungen und verantwortest den Umsatz in deinem Kundenstamm.
Du erkennst ungenutzte CARvinci-Funktionen bei deinen Kunden und entwickelst daraus konkrete Cross- und Upsell-Ansätze.
Du arbeitest eng mit Vertrieb, Produkt und Support zusammen und bringst Kundenfeedback strukturiert zurück ins Unternehmen.

Qualifikation

Erfahrung im Account Management oder Customer Success - idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld.
Verhandlungssicherheit auf Entscheiderebene und Erfahrung im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Ausgeprägtes Prozessverständnis und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte klar zu vermitteln.
Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit hoher Service- und Abschlussorientierung.
Abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse.

Benefits

Faire Vergütung - marktgerecht und regelmäßig überprüft.
Büro in Münster - vor Ort und hybrid.

title: ANALISTA PRODUTOS PL
description:
Nós somos a Cogna , a maior e mais completa empresa de serviços educacionais do país.
Com quase 60 anos de história e mais de 60 marcas, atuamos de forma ampla e integrada, com soluções para escolas, governos e estudantes dos 2 aos 100 anos.
Entre nossas marcas estão Anglo, Red Balloon e Anhanguera, além das editoras Ática, Saraiva, Scipione, que refletem a diversidade e a força do nosso ecossistema educacional.
Contamos com mais de 26 mil colaboradores e o nosso propósito é claro: oferecer soluções educacionais que impulsionam pessoas e organizações a construírem uma melhor versão de si.
Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!
- Liderar uma squad da jornada de ingresso, definindo a visão e a estratégia de produto.
- Trabalhar com stakeholders internos e externos para entender necessidades e prioridades.
- Definir e priorizar o backlog de produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos da empresa.
- Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.
- Analisar dados e métricas para informar decisões de produto e otimizar resultados.
- Desenvolver e implementar planos de lançamento e go-to-market para novos produtos e funcionalidades.
- Conduzir alinhamento com stakeholder.
- Conduzir o time no modelo de PI Planning.
- Incentivando uma cultura de inovação e experimentação dentro da squad.
- Metodologia ágil SCRUM/jira
- Graduação em Administração, Marketing, Engenharia ou área relacionada.
- MBA ou certificação em gestão de produtos é um plus.
- Experiência em gestão de produtos em empresas de educação ou tecnologia.
- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e frameworks de gestão de produtos.
- Habilidades em liderança e gestão de equipes.
- Excelente comunicação e habilidades interpessoais.
- Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante mudança.
- Habilidades em análise de dados e inteligência de negócios.
Informações adicionais
O que você pode esperar da gente?

• Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna .

• Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.

• Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.

• Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

• Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).

• Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.

• Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.

• Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.

• Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.

• Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.

• Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.

• Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.
Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Enterprise Standards Analyst
description:
A DAY IN THE LIFE
An experienced and productive professional responsible for analyzing the day-to-day maintenance of the Blattner operating system and process improvement program, focusing on increasing all process outputs, as well as capability and efficiency of processes by developing, refining, implementing, training, and auditing.
STEP INTO THE ROLE

• Aligns Blattner 's business goals to be an industry leader by improving and implementing procedures and processes as directed.

• Participates in discussions with market segments and departments regarding the design, development, refinement, implementation, and execution of standardized processes and procedures.

• Identifies risk and process gaps, potential process enhancements, and/or inefficiencies and seeks assistance on more advanced matters.

• Supports the implementation of new or changed processes by communicating with all affected areas of the business and assisting with a smooth implementation.

• Collaborates with Subject Matter Experts, department, and project personnel to identify and alleviate pain points, gaps, interdependencies, design, and implementation of future state(s) within the Blattner operating system.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

• Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Business, Engineering (Industrial or Manufacturing), or related field; or equivalent combinations of education and experience.

• Three (3) or more years of progressive related experience required, preferably in construction management, business management, industrial engineering, quality, safety, electrical, or similar type role.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

• Technical writing experience and an understanding of process improvement methodologies is preferred.

• Be proficient with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Project, and Outlook).

• Ability to travel 15-35% of the time.

$68,684.00 - $99,593.00 Individual Compensation to be determined based on the applicant's applicable experience and qualifications balanced against internal equity. WHO ARE WE?

• Dramatically increase email-driven bookings from our existing subscriber base, while amplifying the message of creativity as connection.

• Strategically plan, segment, and execute email marketing campaigns, including A/B tests and lifecycle nurturing.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to improve landing pages and user flows with a focus on storytelling and experience.

• Use data to continuously test, learn, and refine growth strategies that honor our mission.

• Champion the storytelling that brings VAWAA ’s creative and cultural mission to life in every message.

Who you are:

• You have proven experience growing newsletters or email programs focused on driving meaningful conversions and business growth (beyond editorial content).

• Exceptional copywriter who crafts clear, compelling, and emotionally resonant emails, landing pages, and CTAs that inspire action and convey deep human connection.

• Comfortable with data and metrics, running growth experiments, and making decisions based on results.

Why join us?

At VAWAA , you’ll help bring creative, authentic human connection to life on a global scale . You’ll have direct ownership of growth strategies with real impact, in a mission-driven environment that values creativity, authenticity, and meaningful experiences. This is your chance to make a difference through storytelling and growth that honors the power of hands-on artistry and shared creative journeys.

description:

Máš jedinečnou šanci být u toho hned od prvního dne. Budeš to ty, kdo v Opatovicích pohlídá, aby auta pro naše kurýry byla vždy v perfektním stavu a připravená na rozvoz. Ke spolupráci nepotřebuješ znát složité opravy motorů - stačí, když tě baví auta, rád/a komunikuješ s lidmi a chceš nechat svůj otisk na projektu, který budujeme úplně od nuly. Přidej se mezi Rohlíky! :-)

Co tě u nás čeká?

- Péče o auta v provozu: Tvým denním chlebem bude kontrola vozidel, provozních kapalin, výbavy a povinného příslušenství.

- Kontakt s kurýry: Budeš s řidiči denně komunikovat a řešit s nimi stav aut, aby celý náš vozový park šlapal jako po drátkách.

- Drobné opravy: Všechny složitější věci za nás řeší autorizované servisy. Ty si vezmeš na starost jen drobné manuální úkony a běžnou údržbu.

- Technická agenda: Povedeš si pravidelné záznamy a zápisy do technických tabulek, ať máme v datech pořádek.

Jak si tě představujeme?

- Vztah k autům a ŘP sk. B: Auta tě zkrátka baví a jsi aktivní řidič/ka. Předchozí zkušenosti z oboru jsou výhodou, ale ne podmínkou.

- Komunikativnost a týmový duch: Rád/a jednáš s lidmi, umíš se domluvit a potáhneš s námi za jeden provaz.

- Spolehlivost a zručnost: Jsi zodpovědný člověk, nebojíš se vzít za práci a nechybí ti manuální zručnost.

- Práce s PC: Zvládneš běžnou administrativu a zápis dat do počítače.

- Směnový provoz: Nevadí ti pracovat v režimu krátký/dlouhý týden (střídání ranních a odpoledních směn).

Co ti za tvou skvělou práci nabídneme?

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma - nakupuj s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Možnost placeného volna - když si potřebuješ pořádně odpočnout.

description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

About ALEC
The American Legislative Exchange Council is America’s largest nonpartisan, voluntary membership organization of state legislators dedicated to the principles of limited government, free markets and federalism. Comprised of nearly one-quarter of the country’s state legislators and stakeholders from across the policy spectrum, ALEC members represent more than 60 million Americans and provide jobs to more than 30 million people in the United States.
 
All Americans deserve an efficient, effective and accountable government that puts the people in control. ALEC provides a forum for experts to discuss business and economic issues facing the states. The ALEC model policy library is home to dynamic and innovative ideas that reduce the cost of everyday life and ensure economic freedom. ALEC ideas and publications are the product of countless hours of research, debate and discussion and serve as a toolkit for anyone who wants to increase the effectiveness and reduce the size, reach and cost of government. ALEC is proud to offer real solutions to the top issues facing the states, and the strength of the ALEC family is proof that good ideas are better when shared.
 
About the Role
The Membership and Development Intern would work closely with the entire membership department on fundraising efforts. He/she would assist with membership outreach to both legislative and private sector members and help members maximize their membership experience with the organization.
 
The intern would work closely with the membership team to understand the goals and big picture of non-profit fundraising. Daily activities will include assisting with renewal efforts, database maintenance and member correspondence.

Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Our admissions office treats all program participants and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of color, race, religion, religious creed, sex, gender or gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy (including medical needs which may arise from pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), military and veteran status, genetic information, marital or familial status, political affiliation, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

Following the acquisition of Tooploox, a premier AI and product development company, Solvd now offers true end-to-end delivery-from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.

We are looking for a Video & Streaming Engineer to join a greenfield digital news platform build for a major international news brand. Video is not a feature here - it is the product. The platform is built around an always-on livestream, automated broadcast clip ingestion, and a player architecture that needs to perform reliably under the extreme traffic conditions of breaking-news events.

You'll own the video and streaming layer end-to-end: platform integration, adaptive playback, livestream workflows, newsroom clipping tools, advertising, analytics, and resilience testing ahead of launch.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own video, livestream, and player technical implementation across the platform.

- Integrate the selected video platform and player with the broader content and delivery architecture.

- Implement adaptive bitrate streaming and device-aware playback across web and mobile environments.

- Support livestream and breaking-news streaming workflows - including failover and resilience requirements.

- Implement clipping and newsroom video-processing capabilities for broadcast clip ingestion and editorial use.

- Integrate captions, subtitles, thumbnails, and poster frames.

- Support rights management, availability-window controls, and geoblocking requirements.

- Integrate video advertising and analytics capabilities.

- Implement playback telemetry, error handling, and fallback logic.

- Support load testing, resilience validation, and major-event readiness testing ahead of launch.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Hands-on experience integrating and configuring enterprise video platforms - Brightcove, JW Player, Mux, THEOplayer, or similar.

- Strong understanding of adaptive bitrate streaming - HLS, DASH - and device-aware playback implementation.

- Experience implementing livestream workflows in a production environment.

- Familiarity with video processing concepts - clipping, transcoding, thumbnail generation, caption and subtitle integration.

- Experience integrating video advertising - VAST, VPAID, or similar - and video analytics.

- Ability to implement playback telemetry, error detection, and fallback handling.

- Experience supporting performance and resilience testing for high-traffic video delivery scenarios.

- Strong collaboration skills - able to work across CMS, frontend, and infrastructure teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience delivering video infrastructure for news, media, or broadcast organizations.

- Familiarity with rights management, availability windows, and geoblocking implementation.

- Experience with CDN configuration for video delivery at scale.

- Background working on platforms designed for major-event traffic spikes.

- Familiarity with DRM implementation - Widevine, FairPlay, PlayReady.

- Experience with poster frame, chapter marker, and structured metadata workflows for editorial video.

- Shape real-world AI-driven projects across key industries, working with clients from startup innovation to enterprise transformation.

- Be part of a global team with equal opportunities for collaboration across continents and cultures.

title: BDR Team Manager | French Market (Paris)

Notre mission ?

Donner aux avocats, aux cabinets et aux entreprises un produit d'IA de classe mondiale qui fait gagner du temps, augmente la productivité et redéfinit ce qui est possible dans le monde juridique.

Devenir l'entreprise d'IA la plus innovante.

Construire le nouveau standard de la vente, l'école de référence de la vente B2B.

Nous changeons les règles du jeu, avec une équipe de rockstars en quête de leur prochain grand défi.

- Façonner l'avenir : rejoignez l'équipe qui mène la révolution de l'IA pour les professionnels du droit.

- Grandir entouré de rockstars : collaborez avec des talents de premier plan, dans un environnement qui valorise la créativité, l'ambition et la progression.

- Avoir un impact réel : votre travail influencera directement la manière dont les avocats exercent leur métier - plus efficacement, plus intelligemment.

Chez Lexroom, nous ne promettons pas seulement une évolution de carrière : nous promettons un parcours d'apprentissage, d'impact et de sens. Prêt·e à transformer le monde du droit ?

Vos responsabilités

Nous construisons la machine outbound qui définira la façon dont les équipes juridiques adoptent l'IA à grande échelle. En tant que BDR Team Manager, vous dirigerez et développerez une équipe de BDR chargée de générer du pipeline qualifié sur les segments Mid-Market/Enterprise et SMB, en lien étroit avec les AE, le Marketing et les Partnerships, avec un focus sur le marché français.

- Piloter la création de pipeline sur votre segment : objectifs de meetings tenus, SQL, pipeline qualifié en €, couverture et taux de conversion.

- Manager, coacher et faire grandir les BDR : 1:1 hebdomadaires, coaching d'appels, coaching sur les comptes et les deals, diagnostic des compétences, plans de performance. Relever le niveau sur la qualité, pas seulement sur l'activité.

- Construire un système outbound réplicable : affinage de l'ICP, frameworks de messaging, plays de multi-threading, account plans, séquences (email/téléphone/LinkedIn), traitement des objections et discipline du « next step ».

- Excellence opérationnelle : forecast de génération de pipeline, dashboards, contrôle qualité de l'hygiène CRM, boucles de feedback serrées avec les AE sur la qualité et le traitement des leads.

- Recrutement et onboarding : sourcer et interviewer les talents BDR, structurer le plan d'onboarding, piloter la montée en productivité avec des jalons clairs.

- Alignement transverse : transformer les retours du marché en inputs produit et marketing, coordonner les campagnes et les initiatives ABM, créer un handoff propre BDR → AE.

- Expérimentation et itération : tester messages, segments, canaux et séquences en A/B. Industrialiser ce qui marche, arrêter vite ce qui ne marche pas.

- Installer la culture : exigence élevée, ego bas, forte ownership. Les faits avant le ressenti (reporting propre, pas de sandbagging, pas de « happy ears »).

Ce que nous recherchons

- Expérience confirmée de management de BDR en SaaS B2B : des équipes construites et coachées qui atteignent des objectifs de pipeline, pas seulement des objectifs d'activité.

- Maîtrise de l'outbound Enterprise/Mid-Market : prospection par comptes, cartographie multi-interlocuteurs, multi-threading, messaging orienté valeur.

- Vraie qualité de coaching : savoir diagnostiquer l'origine d'une sous-performance (compétence, motivation, territoire ou messaging) et la corriger avec un plan.

- Profil data-driven : à l'aise avec les métriques de funnel, les leviers de conversion, la conception d'expérimentations et le management de la performance.

- Français courant (natif ou C1+) et anglais.

- Maîtrise des outils : CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot), outils de séquençage, Sales Navigator, avec une vraie discipline de reporting.

Ce que nous offrons

- 90 000 € OTE : 60 000 € fixe + 30 000 € varia

At Humana , caring is everything. You look after our members and patients. We look after you. If caring means something to you too, we've got a spot for you. We design competitive and flexible benefits packages to provide our employees a sense of financial security now and in the future.

Humana Healthy Horizons is more than a health plan. We're human care. Humana Healthy Horizons focuses on helping people achieve their best health. The individual in this role will work as an Oklahoma-based, primarily telephonic care manager, assessing and evaluating enrollees' needs and requirements to achieve or maintain optimal wellness by guiding enrollees/families towards and facilitating interaction with appropriate resources for their care and wellbeing. The individual in this role will work in collaboration with the interdisciplinary care management team. This team includes community health workers, housing support specialists, SDOH coordinators, and care management support assistants. This team-based approach is designed to ensure enrollees receive holistic person-centered care. Work assignments for this role are varied and frequently require interpretation and independent determination of the appropriate courses of action. Position Responsibilities:

• Perform telephonic and face-to-face assessments and evaluations of the member's needs and requirements. These assessments aim to achieve and/or maintain an optimal wellness state. The goal is achieved by guiding members/families toward the appropriate resources for the care and overall wellbeing of the member.

• Ensure member is progressing towards desired outcomes by monitoring care through assessments and/or evaluations.

• Create member care plans. Understand department, segment, and organizational strategy and operating objectives, including their linkages to related areas.

• Employ a variety of strategies, approaches, and techniques to manage an Enrollee's behavioral, physical, environmental, and psycho-social health needs.

• Ensure Enrollees are progressing toward desired outcomes by monitoring their assessments and evaluations.

• Identify and resolve barriers that hinder effective care and ensures through continuous monitoring of assessments and evaluations that the Enrollee is progressing toward desired outcomes.

• Follow established guidelines/procedures.

• Collaborate with providers and community services to promote quality and cost-effective outcomes.

Use your skills to make an impact

• Must Reside in Oklahoma

• Active Registered Nurse (RN) license, or a Licensed Master Level Social Worker (LCSW, LPC, LMFT)

• Minimum 1-year Behavioral Health clinical experience

• 2 or more years of experience of in-home case or care management

• Experience working with Medicaid and/or Medicare Enrollees to coordinate services, care needs, or benefits.

title: Manager, Inside Sales
description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.  

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock , TPG (The Rise Fund) , SoftBank, Glynn Capital , NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As Manager of Inside Sales at Human Interest, your primary responsibility will be to coach and develop a high-performing team. The team is responsible for engaging new partners for lead generation of small businesses to become part of the fastest-growing 401(k) company in the world. They will manage a comprehensive sales funnel, requiring mastery in both acquiring net new partners and cultivating ongoing relationships to ensure a continual flow of leads through their pipeline.
The team will look to your guidance and mentorship to help enable their success. You’re the right fit for this role if you are passionate about accelerating revenue, comfortable rolling up your sleeves, and have a strong bias to insight-driven action. You should be naturally curious and have the “go deep” mindset. And as we go 24,791 mph, you should be comfortable with change.

What you get to do every day

• Lead a Tech-Enabled Engine: Spearhead a high-velocity inside sales partnership engine designed to scale referral agreements and expand nationwide market reach.

• Scale Messaging & Sequences: Continuously test and refine persona-aligned outreach sequences and talk tracks to optimize connect rates and meeting conversions.

• Manage Full-Funnel Execution: Oversee pipeline performance across the entire partner lifecycle, from net-new partner acquisition to ongoing relationship management and AE handoffs.

• Align Cross-Functionally: Collaborate with Revenue Operations and Partnership leads to establish operational SLAs, refine target list criteria, and streamline automated lead routing.

• Elevate Rep Competency: Conduct rigorous 1:1 coaching, weekly activity tracking, and bi-weekly call reviews to sharpen value-based pitching, objection handling, and partner negotiations.

• Drive Data-Backed Forecasting: Maintain rigorous accountability around team performance, providing weekly commit forecasts based on activity volume, lead-to-opportunity conversion, and downstream revenue impact.

• Optimize Funnel Integrity: Monitor appointment conversion and follow-up cadences to eliminate drop-off, enforcing key operational targets like maintaining an 80% to 90% show rate.

• Institutionalize Best Practices: Transform high-performing manual prospecting tactics into scalable, automated playbooks as the experimental motion matures.

Key metrics include:

• Team consistently hitting quota (not missing more than two consecutive months)

• Lead and motivate a team of individuals

• Ensure minimal drop off for appointments attended, maintaining an 80% to 90% show rate

• Sales metrics:

• Lead to Opportunity rate

• Lead to Closed Won rate

• Performance metrics:

• Daily activity tracking

• Partner activity follow up

What you bring to the role

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred.

• Proven experience in a Sales Development Representative, role or a similar sales position.

• Minimum of 3 years of Sales team management experience

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About us

SwimOutlet is the largest online specialty retailer for swimming and water sports in the US, and part of Spiraledge, whose brands include EverydayYoga, Swim.com, Practyce and Tend. We are a small marketing team running more than ten million dollars a year of paid media in house across about ten channels, and we move fast.

The role

You own SwimOutlet's organic social presence end to end, and you own the production of our social and paid social creative. Publishing and scheduling are part of it, and so is repurposing what we already have. We are looking for a maker: someone who shoots and edits video, produces UGC, cuts motion graphics and builds statics, and who can make content that is authentically of the swim world and content that actually sells product. Knowing the difference between those two things is most of the job.

You will have internal design and digital media support and a freelance budget to extend your capacity. The output is still yours.

You will also run our ambassador program as a measurable channel, manage community, and work weekly with the CMO on the paid content pipeline.

You will not buy media or run the ad accounts; our paid media team does that. You will be expected to read the results with us every week and change what you make because of them.

What you will own

Content production

• Make the work. You are our primary producer of social and paid social creative across short-form video, UGC, motion graphics and statics.

• Shoot and edit on demand and on location, including on a pool deck and at meets, around launches and campaign moments.

• Produce a consistent pipeline of testable creative for Meta and our other paid social channels, agreeing weekly with the CMO on what to make next.

• Direct and produce UGC through our ambassador roster and creator network.

• Publish and schedule across our channels. This is a hands-on role and posting is part of it.

• Repurpose what we already have into new formats and placements: cutting longer footage into shorts, reworking UGC into paid ads, adapting statics across surfaces.

• Use our internal designers, the digital media team and external freelancers to extend your capacity. They support the output, you own it.

• Use AI tools wherever they genuinely speed things up: ideation, scripting, editing, and image or video generation.

Channel strategy and operations

• Own SwimOutlet's and our private label Sporti's organic social presence end to end across prioritized channels: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts.

• Run a full audit of our branded social channels in your first 60 days and recommend what to prioritize, maintain or sunset.

• Operate those channels to a high standard: planning, production, publishing, community management and performance tracking.

• Manage Tolstoy shoppable video for on-site and retention relevance.

Creative testing and performance

• Lead creative ideation and testing for paid social: hooks, angles, copy, formats.

• Meet weekly with the CMO to review paid creative performance and agree what to produce more of.

• Own creative-side performance analysis: CTR, CPM, thumbstop rate, hook rate, hold rate, engagement rate and outbound CTR.

• Turn that analysis into clear calls on which angles and formats to double down on.

Community and ambassador program

• Run the ambassador program as a measurable channel, including UGC and influencer sourcing within it.

• Recruit, brief, track output and evaluate ROI per ambassador, and refine the roster toward the highest-value partners.

• Manage community engagement across DMs, comments and tagged content.

• Escalate anything sensitive on PR, CX or legal with good judgement about what needs to come to the CMO.

Product and merchandising alignment

• Keep a clear feed of prioritization inputs from the buying and planning teams so social reflects business priorities.

• Surface priority products, launches and promotional moments through our existing marketing meeting

- Content understanding and embeddings are core to your work. You research and develop information-rich user and ad embeddings using unsupervised and generative approaches, directly improving the quality of predictions across both Playtime and adjoe Ads.

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Why this role is on the menu

Instacart operates at the intersection of food access, gig economy labor, and marketplace regulation, making legislative and regulatory engagement a core business function, not an afterthought. As the regulatory landscape around gig economy platforms, marketplace operators, and labor practices continues to evolve rapidly, the Legislative and Labor Team needs a skilled lawyer to analyze emerging requirements, build compliance frameworks, and shape the regulatory conversation before it shapes Instacart. Without this role, gaps in legal analysis and compliance strategy could create operational risk across multiple areas of the business. A year from now, Instacart will have stronger legal frameworks in place, clearer compliance strategies across regulatory domains, and a more coordinated voice in the cross-industry conversations that define the rules of the road for the gig economy.

• Cross-functional regulatory responses are coordinated with clarity: Policy and Government Affairs, Operations, Product, and Communications teams have a consistent, well-analyzed legal perspective on legislative matters affecting Instacart's operations.

• Legal frameworks and compliance best practices for meeting legislative and regulatory mandates are developed and documented, giving the company a foundation to navigate evolving requirements with confidence.

• Instacart's relationships with external counsel, trade associations, and industry partners are actively managed, with cross-industry initiatives underway that contribute to shaping the regulatory conversation in favor of gig economy innovation.

• Expertise in emerging areas of law relevant to Instacart's business is built and shared internally, ensuring the team is prepared to respond to new legal challenges as they arise.

 

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

• Juris Doctor (JD) degree.

• 3+ years of experience practicing law.

• Demonstrated ability to synthesize, analyze, and provide precise legal advice in response to legislative updates.

• Experience working with legislative bodies, government agencies, or regulatory matters.

• Proven success in supporting compliance initiatives and executing legal frameworks.

• Understanding of legislative processes and the regulatory landscape.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience with legislative or regulatory strategy.

• Familiarity with issues facing marketplace platform companies, gig economy platform companies, or similarly highly regulated businesses

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians.
